cloud-hsm-cannot-pause.title: Cloud HSM cannot be paused
cloud-hsm-cannot-pause.body: This estimate bills fewer than a full month of hours, but Cloud HSM is billed hourly from provisioning and cannot be paused; only deleting the cluster ends charges. Part-month figures are only right if the cluster is really deleted and re-created.

citation.quote: It's billed hourly and cannot be paused or stopped. Only deletion ends charges.

cloud-hsm-restore-target-bills.title: A standby restore target is billed in full
cloud-hsm-restore-target-bills.body: With two or more clusters, remember that restoring a backup needs a destination Cloud HSM that is not activated, and billing starts when a resource is provisioned, not when it is initialized. A standby cluster kept ready for recovery is therefore billed for every hour.

citation.quote: You can restore a backup to another Azure Cloud HSM resource in any region, if the destination Cloud HSM resource is not in an activated state.

more.quote: Billing starts when you provision a resource, rather than when you finish initializing the HSM resource.
